fact_english: Ube (Dioscorea alata, purple yam) is a true yam, genus Dioscorea, family Dioscoreaceae. It is not kamote (sweet potato, Ipomoea batatas, morning glory family Convolvulaceae) and not gabi (taro, Colocasia esculenta, arum family Araceae).

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang ube, par, hindi kamote at hindi gabi. Isa itong uri ng yam!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Ilang taon ko nang mali ang tawag. Hindi ko na sasabihin kanino.
